trace_interface.generation: per physical role/slot starts-1; advances to0 for first input copy or Cfirstcompute row; expectedA/Cfloor(s/2), Bfloor(q/2)
trace_interface.byte_offset: copy external byteoffset s*16384 or t*16384; compute first output element offset(s*16*256+t*16)*4; actual tile footprint16rows*16columns rowpitch1024
trace_interface.size_bytes: all copies16384; compute writes1024bytes as a strided tile, not a contiguous1024byte interval; metadata value does not reduce MACcount
trace_interface.job_id: global unique positive copyjob, includes final blockingCcopy; all nonjob events-1
trace_interface.slot_fields: compute records actual A/B/C slot and current generation after precompute barrier; other events-1
trace_interface.copy_semantics: synchronous CPU memcpy from call start to completed copy; hero API naming retained solely to execute original control structure
